sources.title: Cecilia Immergreen (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It includes a [[detached collar]] with a [[red ascot]] and a [[red gem]], a [[white romper|white]] [[strapless romper|strapless]] [[romper]] (although it is sometimes depicted as a [[strapless shirt]] and [[bloomers]]), [[white sleeves|white]] [[puffy long sleeves|puffy long]] [[detached sleeves]], an [[underbust]] [[cross-laced corset|cross-laced]] [[green corset]], a [[see-through skirt|see-through]] [[green skirt|green]] [[high-low_skirt|high-low]] [[miniskirt]] with [[gold trim]] featuring [[gears]] and [[musical note ornament]]s and a [[large bow|large]] [[back bow]].

sources.title: Cecilia Immergreen (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It includes a [[white shirt|white]] [[strapless shirt|strapless]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless shirt]], [[white sleeves|white]] [[detached sleeves]], a [[detached collar]] with a [[red ascot]], a [[cross-laced corset|cross-laced]] [[green corset]], a [[see-through skirt|see-through]] [[green skirt]] with [[gears]] and [[musical note]] ornaments over a pair of [[short shorts|short]] [[puffy shorts|puffy]] [[white shorts]] (some artists may omit this).

profiles.notes: Official first costume; optional lance/violin excluded.
